access: A Municipality of Anchorage public facility, open to anyone with no membership or residency requirement. The standard advance booking window is five days, with an explicit out-of-state exception letting travellers request tee times earlier through the course's Out of State page.

No membership required. Book online through EzLinks (quintero2.ezlinksgolf.com, or quinteroazres1.ezlinksgolf.com for single players) up to 90 days ahead; a credit card is required and cancellation is 48 hours. Golf Digest labels the course "Public" while operator Troon's own page says "Semi-private"; the guide publishes the disagreement unresolved.

Open to the public, but the tee sheet is gated by a hotel stay. Guests of Pebble Beach Resorts — The Lodge at Pebble Beach, The Inn at Spanish Bay, Casa Palmero — reserve up to 18 months ahead, subject to a minimum stay the resort does not publish as a fixed figure; non-guests can reserve only 24 hours ahead. A cart fee is mandatory for non-resort guests.

Members-first club. Non-members book by phone at (970) 663-5063 up to seven days ahead, Monday to Thursday after 11am and Friday to Sunday after 1pm; Thursday through Sunday is reserved to the membership and the TPC Network, with leftover times released 24 hours out. The operator's own overlapping wording leaves Thursday contested, and the guide leaves it contested.

Public access through the club's own site or by phone at 1-800-523-2464, with no membership and no hotel stay required. In peak season, 18 May to 13 September, phone bookings are capped at 45 days ahead while online booking runs beyond it; Coeur d'Alene Tribal Members are exempt. Resort lodging confers no tee-time priority — the Stay & Play package affects price only.

Daily-fee public, with no membership and no resident or non-resident tiering. Online tee times run up to 60 days ahead through ForeUp, or by phone at 866-264-4455, with the card charged at booking. Aerification closes the course 14-17 April and, tentatively, 20-23 October.
course: Cog Hill Golf & Country Club: Course No. 4 – Dubsdread

access: Daily-fee public course with no membership. The operator's own policy page states "Starting times may be reserved up to 14 days in advance"; groups of sixteen or more book through the pro shop, and cancellation notice is 24 hours.

Public and Kansas State University-owned, with no membership or residency requirement. Booking runs from colberthills.com out to colberthills.cps.golf, whose reservation subdomain 403s and has never been archived, so the days-in-advance window is unsourceable and is stated as such rather than invented. The 2026 seasonal rates of $115/$105/$80 (1 April to 10 November, cart included) carry the operator's own "rates change through the season" qualifier. The whole facility closes 13-15 and 27-29 September, 26 November and 24-25 December 2026.

Daily-fee with no membership - Golf Digest records the facility type as Daily Fee and the course as not private. Reservations are required, though walk-ons are taken when possible; players register in the golf shop, and booking is limited to the current calendar year. Cancellation is a 7-day window charging 100% per player and may vary by group size - the FAQ's four-tier and the rates page's three-tier schedules differ, and both are stated. The 2026 season runs 1 April to 30 November.
course: Arcadia Bluffs Golf Club: The Bluffs Course
second_course: Arcadia Bluffs Golf Club: The South Course

access: Public course, no membership required. Booking is phone-only at (218) 865-8030 - every "Book Tee Times" control on the resort's site is a tel: link and there is no online tee sheet. The 2026 rate table runs $100/$130/$130/$100 across four seasonal bands with a $75 replay, and the 48-hour notice governs cancellation, not booking. Late Season runs 28 September to 11 October 2026; the 2026 opening date is published only as "TBD."

Public resort course, no membership. Non-resort guests book up to 30 days ahead - 60 days for play falling 15 June to 15 August - at book.rguest.com or 1-800-225-6343; resort guests book by phone only, at the resort rate. The course closes for aeration 8-10 September 2026, with recovery to 20 September, and off-season 1 January to 5 March and 7 to 31 December.

Open to non-member and non-resort-guest play after 12:00 PM in the 2026 season; no membership and no resort room required. Book at wildernessclub.ezlinksgolf.com or call (406) 296-8264. Operator Escalante Golf stated a 2024 intent to eventually go fully private; that is an intent, not the current rule. No dated green fee is published.

Public daily-fee course with no membership tier - the operator states "We do not currently offer memberships." Tee times are booked online through ForeUp for 2026 and Whoosh from 2027, on a $25 per-golfer nonrefundable deposit; cancelling outside a week refunds everything but the deposit, inside a week nothing. $160 per golfer with cart. The 2026 season runs 16 May to 1 October.

Golf Digest labels it "Public," but the operator's own terms are narrower: a qualifying MGM Resorts hotel stay is required to be considered. On weekdays a hotel guest requests a time through the concierge; weekends are held for comped players with a casino host and a gambling credit line. There is no public tee sheet.

No published non-member booking route. Golf Digest ranks it first and labels it "Public," with a "Daily Fee" facility type and a $105 weekend fee as of the ranking data's own 14 November 2025 update; the club's own site calls itself "a private club," puts every booking control behind a member login, and publishes no green fee and no guest policy. The only sourced avenue is the phone, (701) 852-3591. The guide publishes the disagreement between the two sources rather than resolving it.

Public (Golf Digest label). Daily-fee resort course: the resort publishes a day-guest green fee for every month of the year. Day guests booking inside 21 days pay the standard day-guest rate; booking more than 21 days ahead requires an April-to-mid-November date, the premium day-guest rate, a tee time after 10:00 a.m., and no more than one year in advance. Resort lodging guests book earlier and at the lower resort-guest rate.

Public course, no membership required. Non-members book on the club's own tee sheet at redrock.cps.golf (Club Prophet Systems) or by phone at (605) 718-4710. How far ahead a time may be taken is published nowhere reachable - the booking engine 403s behind Cloudflare and no archived capture carries it - so the advance-booking window is stated as unknown rather than estimated.
course: The Golf Club At Red Rock
facility: The Golf Club At Red Rock

access: Non-members book by phone at 435-222-7830 or online through Chronogolf, on a 30-day public booking window stated by the operator. A room booking is optional and affects price only ($250-450 seasonal tiers); solo online booking is restricted. The course is closed to all play September 14 to October 6, 2026 for the PGA TOUR event.

Public course, no membership required. Walking only, with a push/pull cart included; book online at chambersbaygolf.com or call 253-460-4653. Residency-based rates open up to three months ahead from the first of the month; the non-resident prepaid tier opens January 1 for April-to-October play. Single players may join an existing group but cannot book an open time. Cancellation terms are tiered.

Public, with no resort stay required - Kohler's own FAQ confirms non-guests may play. The resort's reservations page splits booking by lead time: inside 30 days, book online; beyond 30 days, and for every package, call 855-444-2838 or use the golf inquiry form. The same FAQ flags a Straits-specific warning that non-resort guests "may have booking restrictions" which no page anywhere specifies; the guide publishes that caveat live and unresolved rather than folding it into the 30-day rule.

Semi-private, with no lodging or membership requirement. Non-members play a fixed 1pm-2pm afternoon block daily, but booking itself is unrestricted — online at any hour, or by phone; the block governs play, not booking. The 2026 daily fee is $195 through May 22 and $300 from May 23 to close, including tax, cart and practice. Open early May to mid-October.
